description: Agents born at OPSIN: every agent the lab built from parts that held up, with its name, its genome (the exact parts, in order), the agent it came from, the signed verdict that brought it in, its life since (every later notebook that measured the same agent), its birth certificate signed by the lab and where the record holds it on Elysium, and the exact request it runs with. Narrow it to one suite, or to the agents that are each setting's best now.

alive.description: Only the agents that are their setting's best now
